```{r Functions}
### XXX Functions ###

### From ChatGPT

library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(effsize)
library(lsr)
library(gridExtra)

auto_explore_AB <- function(data, groupA, groupB, filename="auto_explore_AB.pdf", alpha=0.05, log_transform=TRUE,
                             numeric_numeric=TRUE, numeric_categorical=TRUE, categorical_categorical=TRUE) {
  
  sig_text <- function(p) if(p < alpha) "statistically significant" else "not statistically significant"
  
  log_if_skewed <- function(x) {
    if(log_transform && is.numeric(x) && all(x>0)) {
      p <- shapiro.test(x)$p.value
      if(p < 0.01) {
        cat("⚠ Strongly non-normal numeric variable. Applying log10 transform.\n")
        x <- log10(x)
      }
    }
    return(x)
  }
  
  # Initialize summary table
  summary_tbl <- data.frame(Var1=character(),
                            Var2=character(),
                            Test=character(),
                            p_value=numeric(),
                            Effect_Size=numeric(),
                            Strength=character(),
                            Interpretation=character(),
                            stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  
  # Open PDF and redirect console output
  pdf(filename, width=8, height=6)
  sink(file = filename, append=TRUE, split=TRUE)
  
  for(a in groupA) {
    for(b in groupB) {
      var1 <- a
      var2 <- b
      v1 <- data[[var1]]
      v2 <- data[[var2]]
      
      is_v1_num <- is.numeric(v1)
      is_v2_num <- is.numeric(v2)
      
      # Skip pairs not selected
      if((is_v1_num && is_v2_num && !numeric_numeric) ||
         (is_v1_num && !is_v2_num && !numeric_categorical) ||
         (!is_v1_num && !is_v2_num && !categorical_categorical)) next
      
      cat("\n============================================\n")
      cat("Analyzing:", var1, "vs", var2, "\n")
      
      #### Numeric vs Numeric ####
      if(is_v1_num && is_v2_num) {
        v1 <- log_if_skewed(v1)
        v2 <- log_if_skewed(v2)
        cat("📈 Numeric vs Numeric\n")
        
        print(
          ggplot(data.frame(v1,v2), aes(x=v1,y=v2)) +
            geom_point(color="blue") +
            geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color="red") +
            labs(x=var1, y=var2, title=paste("Scatter plot:", var1, "vs", var2))
        )
        
        sh1 <- shapiro.test(v1)$p.value
        sh2 <- shapiro.test(v2)$p.value
        normal <- (sh1 > alpha) && (sh2 > alpha)
        test <- if(normal) cor.test(v1,v2, method="pearson") else cor.test(v1,v2, method="spearman")
        test_name <- if(normal) "Pearson correlation" else "Spearman correlation"
        
        r_val <- as.numeric(test$estimate)
        corr_strength <- if(abs(r_val)<0.3) "no/very weak correlation" else if(abs(r_val)<0.7) "moderate correlation" else "strong correlation"
        interpretation <- sig_text(test$p.value)
        
        summary_tbl <- rbind(summary_tbl, data.frame(Var1=var1,
                                                     Var2=var2,
                                                     Test=test_name,
                                                     p_value=round(test$p.value,4),
                                                     Effect_Size=round(r_val,3),
                                                     Strength=corr_strength,
                                                     Interpretation=interpretation,
                                                     stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
        
        cat("Test:", test_name, "\n")
        cat("r =", round(r_val,3), ", p-value =", signif(test$p.value,3), "\n")
        cat("Interpretation:", interpretation, "with", corr_strength, "\n")
      }
      
      #### Numeric vs Categorical ####
      else if(is_v1_num && !is_v2_num) {
        v1 <- log_if_skewed(v1)
        g <- as.factor(v2)
        cat("📊 Numeric vs Categorical\n")
        
        print(
          ggplot(data.frame(v1,g), aes(x=v1, fill=g)) +
            geom_histogram(alpha=0.5, position="identity", bins=30) +
            labs(x=var1, fill=var2, title=paste("Histogram of", var1, "by", var2))
        )
        print(
          ggplot(data.frame(v1,g), aes(x=g, y=v1, fill=g)) +
            geom_boxplot(alpha=0.6) +
            labs(x=var2, y=var1, title=paste("Boxplot of", var1, "by", var2))
        )
        
        sh_p <- tapply(v1,g,function(x) if(length(unique(x))>3) shapiro.test(x)$p.value else NA)
        normal <- all(sh_p[!is.na(sh_p)]>alpha)
        equal_var <- leveneTest(v1~g)$`Pr(>F)`[1] > alpha
        
        if(normal && equal_var && length(levels(g))==2) test <- t.test(v1~g,var.equal=TRUE)
        else if(normal && !equal_var && length(levels(g))==2) test <- t.test(v1~g,var.equal=FALSE)
        else if(normal && length(levels(g))>2 && equal_var) test <- aov(v1~g)
        else if(normal && length(levels(g))>2 && !equal_var) test <- oneway.test(v1~g,var.equal=FALSE)
        else if(!normal && length(levels(g))==2) test <- wilcox.test(v1~g)
        else test <- kruskal.test(v1~g)
        
        # Effect size
        effect_size_val <- NA
        effect_strength <- NA
        if(length(levels(g))==2) {
          d <- cohen.d(v1 ~ g)$estimate
          effect_strength <- if(abs(d)<0.2) "small" else if(abs(d)<0.5) "medium" else "large"
          effect_size_val <- round(d,3)
        } else if(length(levels(g))>2) {
          es <- NA
          if(class(test)[1]=="aov") {
            es <- etaSquared(test, anova=TRUE)$eta.sq[1]
          } else if(class(test)[1]=="htest" && inherits(test, "kruskal.test")) {
            H <- test$statistic
            n <- sum(!is.na(v1))
            k <- length(levels(g))
            es <- (H - k + 1)/(n - k)
          }
          if(!is.na(es)) {
            effect_strength <- if(es<0.01) "small" else if(es<0.06) "medium" else "large"
            effect_size_val <- round(es,3)
          }
        }
        
        if(class(test)[1]=="htest") p_val <- test$p.value else p_val <- summary(test)[[1]]["Pr(>F)"][1]
        interpretation <- sig_text(p_val)
        
        summary_tbl <- rbind(summary_tbl, data.frame(Var1=var1,
                                                     Var2=var2,
                                                     Test=class(test)[1],
                                                     p_value=round(p_val,4),
                                                     Effect_Size=effect_size_val,
                                                     Strength=effect_strength,
                                                     Interpretation=interpretation,
                                                     stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
        
        cat("Effect size:", effect_size_val, "→", effect_strength, "\n")
        cat("p-value =", signif(p_val,3), "\nInterpretation:", interpretation, "\n")
      }
      
      #### Categorical vs Categorical ####
      else if(!is_v1_num && !is_v2_num) {
        v1 <- as.factor(v1)
        v2 <- as.factor(v2)
        cat("📊 Categorical vs Categorical\n")
        
        tbl <- table(v1,v2)
        print(
          ggplot(data.frame(v1,v2), aes(x=v1, fill=v2)) +
            geom_bar(position="dodge") +
            labs(x=var1, fill=var2, title=paste("Bar plot:", var1, "vs", var2))
        )
        
        if(any(tbl<5)) test <- fisher.test(tbl) else test <- chisq.test(tbl)
        p_val <- test$p.value
        interpretation <- sig_text(p_val)
        
        summary_tbl <- rbind(summary_tbl, data.frame(Var1=var1,
                                                     Var2=var2,
                                                     Test=class(test)[1],
                                                     p_value=round(p_val,4),
                                                     Effect_Size=NA,
                                                     Strength=NA,
                                                     Interpretation=interpretation,
                                                     stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
        
        cat("Test chosen.\n")
        cat("p-value =", signif(p_val,3), "\nInterpretation:", interpretation, "\n")
        cat("Contingency table:\n")
        print(tbl)
      }
      
      rm(v1,v2)
      gc()
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n============================================\n")
  cat("Summary of all comparisons\n")
  print(summary_tbl)
  
  sink()
  dev.off()
  cat("\n✅ All plots and console output saved to:", filename, "\n")
}
```

```{r DatabaseDownload}
# Connect to Local database server and pull all necessary data, then close connection 
con <- dbConnect(odbc(),
                    Driver = "SQL Server", 
                    Server = Server,
                    Database = Database,
                    Authentication = "ActiveDirectoryIntegrated")

hsdbShellPest <- tbl(con,in_schema("hsdb", "ShellPest")) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(substring(SampleEventID, 1, 2) %in% Estuaries)

hsdbConditionIndex <- tbl(con,in_schema("hsdb", "ConditionIndex")) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(substring(SampleEventID, 1, 2) %in% Estuaries)

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r DataFiltersBasic}
# Adjust data to include necessary fields and exclude incomplete years.
ShellPest <- hsdbShellPest %>% 
  mutate(Section = substring(OysterID, 3, 3),
         FixedLocation = substring(SampleEventID, 19, 22),
         Year = substring(SampleEventID, 8, 11),
         Month = substring(SampleEventID, 12, 13),
         Day = substr(SampleEventID, 14, 15),
         Date = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, Day, sep = "-")),
         Season = case_when(
          month(Date) >= 1 & month(Date) <= 3 ~ "Winter",
          month(Date) >= 4 & month(Date) <= 6 ~ "Spring",
          month(Date) >= 7 & month(Date) <= 9 ~ "Summer",
          month(Date) >= 10 & month(Date) <= 12 ~ "Fall",
          TRUE ~ "Invalid")) %>%
  left_join(hsdbConditionIndex, by = c("OysterID")) %>%
  filter(Year < 2023) %>%
  mutate(Section = factor(Section, levels = c("W", "C", "E")),
         Season = factor(Season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")),
         Month = factor(Month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb)
         ) %>%
  select(OysterID,
         PhotoSurface,
         TotalArea,
         ClionaArea,
         PolydoraArea,
         ClamCount,
         Section,
         FixedLocation,
         Date,
         Month,
         Year,
         Season,
         ProcessedBy,
         ShellHeight,
         TotalWeight) 

# Adjust to provide the sum values needed for calculations
ShellPest1 <- ShellPest %>%
  group_by(OysterID,
           Section,
           FixedLocation,
           Date,
           Month,
           Year,
           Season,
           ProcessedBy,
           ShellHeight,
           TotalWeight) %>%
  summarise(TotalSurfaceArea = sum(TotalArea, na.rm = TRUE),
         TotalExternalArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "E", TotalArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         TotalInternalArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "I", TotalArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         TotalTopArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "T", TotalArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         TotalBottomArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "B", TotalArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         TotalClionaArea = sum(ClionaArea, na.rm = TRUE),
         ClionaExternalArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "E", ClionaArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         ClionaInternalArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "I", ClionaArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         ClionaTopArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "T", ClionaArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         ClionaBottomArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "B", ClionaArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         TotalPolydoraArea = sum(PolydoraArea, na.rm = TRUE),
         PolydoraExternalArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "E", PolydoraArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         PolydoraInternalArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "I", PolydoraArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         PolydoraTopArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "T", PolydoraArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         PolydoraBottomArea = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "B", PolydoraArea, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         TotalClamCount = sum(ClamCount, na.rm = TRUE),
         ClamCountExternal = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "E", ClamCount, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         ClamCountInternal = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 2, 2) == "I", ClamCount, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         ClamCountTop = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "T", ClamCount, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         ClamCountBottom = sum(
           if_else(substring(PhotoSurface, 1, 1) == "B", ClamCount, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
         .groups = "drop"   # removes grouping after summarise
         ) 

# Adjust to provide the calculated values for prevalence and intensity
ShellPest2 <- ShellPest1 %>%
  mutate(ClionaIntensityWholeOyster = if_else(TotalClionaArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(TotalClionaArea / TotalSurfaceArea, 4)),
         ClionaIntensityExternal = if_else(ClionaExternalArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClionaExternalArea / TotalExternalArea, 4)),
         ClionaIntensityInternal = if_else(ClionaInternalArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClionaInternalArea / TotalInternalArea, 4)),
         ClionaIntensityTop = if_else(ClionaTopArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClionaTopArea / TotalTopArea, 4)),
         ClionaIntensityBottom = if_else(ClionaBottomArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClionaBottomArea / TotalBottomArea, 4)),
         PolydoraIntensityWholeOyster = if_else(TotalPolydoraArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(TotalPolydoraArea / TotalSurfaceArea, 4)),
         PolydoraIntensityExternal = if_else(PolydoraExternalArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(PolydoraExternalArea / TotalExternalArea, 4)),
         PolydoraIntensityInternal = if_else(PolydoraInternalArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(PolydoraInternalArea / TotalInternalArea, 4)),
         PolydoraIntensityTop = if_else(PolydoraTopArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(PolydoraTopArea / TotalTopArea, 4)),
         PolydoraIntensityBottom = if_else(PolydoraBottomArea == 0, 0, 
                                              round(PolydoraBottomArea / TotalBottomArea, 4)),
         ClamIntensityWholeOyster = if_else(TotalClamCount == 0, 0, 
                                              round(TotalClamCount / TotalSurfaceArea, 4)),
         ClamIntensityExternal = if_else(ClamCountExternal == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClamCountExternal / TotalExternalArea, 4)),
         ClamIntensityInternal = if_else(ClamCountInternal == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClamCountInternal / TotalInternalArea, 4)),
         ClamIntensityTop = if_else(ClamCountTop == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClamCountTop / TotalTopArea, 4)),
         ClamIntensityBottom = if_else(ClamCountBottom == 0, 0, 
                                              round(ClamCountBottom / TotalBottomArea, 4))
   ) %>%
  select(
    OysterID,
    Section,
    FixedLocation,
    Date,
    Season,
    Month,
    Year,
    ProcessedBy,
    ShellHeight,
    TotalWeight,
    TotalClamCount,
    ClamCountExternal,
    ClamCountInternal,
    ClamCountTop,
    ClamCountBottom,
    ClionaIntensityWholeOyster,
    ClionaIntensityExternal,
    ClionaIntensityInternal,
    ClionaIntensityTop,
    ClionaIntensityBottom,
    PolydoraIntensityWholeOyster,
    PolydoraIntensityExternal,
    PolydoraIntensityInternal,
    PolydoraIntensityTop,
    PolydoraIntensityBottom,
    ClamIntensityWholeOyster,
    ClamIntensityExternal,
    ClamIntensityInternal,
    ClamIntensityTop,
    ClamIntensityBottom) %>%
  ungroup()
```

``` {r}
##### Fit regressions with the Section as a fixed effect and a random effect
# Best fit for these are negative binomial

ShellPest2$TotalWeight_scaled <- scale(ShellPest2$TotalWeight)[,1]

model.A1 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + (1 | TotalWeight),
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2)

model.A1.2 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + scale(TotalWeight),
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2)

model.A2 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + (1 | ShellHeight),
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2)
##### Fit Poisson regressions with the Section as a fixed effect ONLY
model.B <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2)

##### Fit Poisson regressions with the Section as a random effect ONLY
model.C <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ 1 + (1 | Section),
                   ziformula = ~1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2)

### Use AICc to compare the 2 models: we'll use the model with the lowest score for making any inferences moving forward
model.names <- c('Fixed&RandomOyWt', 'Fixed&FixedOyWt', 'Fixed&RandomSH', 'FixedOnly', 'RandomOnly')
aictab(list(model.A1, model.A1.2, model.A2, model.B, model.C), modnames = model.names) #will use one for analysis

##### Assess goodness-of-fit
simulateResiduals(model.A1, n = 500, refit = FALSE, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(model.A1.2, n = 500, refit = FALSE, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(model.A2, n = 500, refit = FALSE, plot = T)
simulateResiduals(model.B, n = 500, refit = FALSE, plot = T)
 # plot(sim_res)
 # testResiduals(model.B)
simulateResiduals(model.C, n = 500, refit = FALSE, plot = T)

##### Look at estimates
summary(model.A1.2)
summary(model.A2)
summary(model.B)
summary(model.C)
```

``` {r}
### Help from Claude
# Optimized glmmTMB models with improved specifications

# Pre-processing: Scale continuous variables once
ShellPest2$TotalWeight_scaled <- scale(ShellPest2$TotalWeight)[,1]
ShellPest2$ShellHeight_scaled <- scale(ShellPest2$ShellHeight)[,1]

# Ensure Section is a factor for proper contrasts
ShellPest2$Section <- as.factor(ShellPest2$Section)

# Model 1 - Using Section and scaled TotalWeight as fixed effect
model1 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model 2 - Using Section and scaled ShellHeight as fixed effect

                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model 3 - Using Section ONLY as fixed effect

# Model comparison approach

)
```

``` {r}
# Optimized glmmTMB models with improved specifications

# Pre-processing: Scale continuous variables once
ShellPest2$TotalWeight_scaled <- scale(ShellPest2$TotalWeight)[,1]
ShellPest2$ShellHeight_scaled <- scale(ShellPest2$ShellHeight)[,1]

# Ensure Section is a factor for proper contrasts
ShellPest2$Section <- as.factor(ShellPest2$Section)

# Model A1 - CORRECTED: TotalWeight should be fixed effect, not random
model.A1 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A1.2 - Simplified (this was already correct)
model.A1.2 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled,
                     dispformula = ~ Section,
                     ziformula = ~ 1,
                     family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                     data = ShellPest2,
                     control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                            optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A2 - Using scaled ShellHeight as fixed effect
model.A2 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + ShellHeight_scaled,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Alternative models with random effects (if you have grouping variables)
# Only use these if you have repeated measures or hierarchical structure

# If you have a grouping variable (e.g., SiteID, SampleID):
# model.A1.random <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + (1 | GroupingVar),
#                          dispformula = ~ Section,
#                          ziformula = ~ 1,
#                          family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
#                          data = ShellPest2)

# Prepare temporal variables
ShellPest2$Season <- as.factor(ShellPest2$Season)
ShellPest2$Year <- as.factor(ShellPest2$Year)  # Categorical for non-linear trends
ShellPest2$Year_numeric <- as.numeric(as.character(ShellPest2$Year))  # For linear trends
ShellPest2$Year_scaled <- scale(ShellPest2$Year_numeric)[,1]  # Scaled for better convergence

# Extended model set: Adding Season and Year systematically

# Model A1 (baseline - your best model)
model.A1 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A3: Add Season (cyclical pattern)
model.A3 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Season,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A4: Add Year as factor (non-linear temporal trend)
model.A4 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Year,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A5: Add Year as linear trend (more parsimonious)
model.A5 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Year_scaled,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A6: Add both Season and Year (factor)
model.A6 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Season + Year,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A7: Add both Season and Year (linear)
model.A7 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Season + Year_scaled,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model A8: Season-Year interaction (test if seasonal patterns change over years)
model.A8 <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Season * Year_scaled,
                   dispformula = ~ Section,
                   ziformula = ~ 1,
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model comparison approach
library(AICcmodavg)

# Create comprehensive model list
models <- list(
  "A1_Baseline" = model.A1,
  "A3_Season" = model.A3,
  "A4_Year_Factor" = model.A4,
  "A5_Year_Linear" = model.A5,
  "A6_Season_Year_Factor" = model.A6,
  "A7_Season_Year_Linear" = model.A7,
  "A8_Season_Year_Interaction" = model.A8
)

# Compare models using AICc
model_comparison <- aictab(models)
print(model_comparison)

# Evidence ratios for model selection
print(paste("Models within 2 AICc units of best model are considered competitive"))
best_aic <- min(model_comparison$AICc)
competitive_models <- model_comparison[model_comparison$AICc - best_aic <= 2, ]
print(competitive_models)

# Model diagnostics
library(DHARMa)
library(performance)

# Detailed analysis of best temporal model (A6_Season_Year_Factor)
best_model <- model.A6  # A6_Season_Year_Factor is clearly the best
print("BEST MODEL: A6 - Section + TotalWeight + Season + Year (as factors)")
print(summary(best_model))

# Calculate R-squared equivalent for count models
library(performance)
r2_values <- r2(best_model)
# print(paste("Conditional R² (fixed + random effects):", round(r2_values$R2_conditional, 3)))
# print(paste("Marginal R² (fixed effects only):", round(r2_values$R2_marginal, 3)))

# Key findings from model selection
print("=== MODEL SELECTION INSIGHTS ===")
print("1. Both Season AND Year are highly important (A6 >> A3 or A4 alone)")
print("2. Non-linear year effects are crucial (A6 >> A7: factor vs linear year)")
print("3. Seasonal patterns are consistent across years (A6 >> A8: no interaction needed)")
print("4. Temporal factors explain MASSIVE variation (ΔAICc = 156 vs baseline)")

improvement_baseline <- 14978.99 - 14822.76
print(paste("Improvement over baseline model: ΔAICc =", round(improvement_baseline, 1)))

# Analyze seasonal and yearly patterns in detail
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)

# 1. SEASONAL PATTERNS
print("=== SEASONAL PATTERNS ===")
season_emm <- emmeans(best_model, ~ Season, type = "response")
season_results <- as.data.frame(season_emm)
print(season_results)

# Plot seasonal effects
# Plot seasonal effects (with correct column names)
# Common emmeans column names are: asymp.LCL/asymp.UCL or lower.CL/upper.CL
if("lower.CL" %in% names(season_results)) {
  lower_col <- "lower.CL"
  upper_col <- "upper.CL"
} else if("asymp.LCL" %in% names(season_results)) {
  lower_col <- "asymp.LCL" 
  upper_col <- "asymp.UCL"
} else {
  # Find confidence interval columns by pattern
  ci_cols <- names(season_results)[grepl("CL|CI", names(season_results))]
  lower_col <- ci_cols[1]
  upper_col <- ci_cols[2]
}

p_season <- ggplot(season_results, aes(x = Season, y = response)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes_string(ymin = lower_col, ymax = upper_col), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Pattern in Clam Counts",

       y = "Predicted Clam Count", x = "Season") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))

min_season <- season_results[which.min(season_results$response), ]

print(paste("Peak season (", max_season$Season, ") has", round(seasonal_ratio, 2), 
            "times more clams than lowest season (", min_season$Season, ")"))

# 3. COMBINED SEASONAL-YEARLY HEATMAP

season_year_emm <- emmeans(best_model, ~ Season * Year, type = "response")
```

``` {r}
# Each row = one oyster, so create binary infection status
print("Creating binary infection variable...")

# Create binary infection status (0 = uninfected, 1 = infected)

ShellPest2$ShellHeight_scaled <- scale(ShellPest2$ShellHeight)[,1]

                   family = binomial(link = "logit"),

                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

                   family = binomial(link = "logit"),
                   data = ShellPest2,
                   control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                          optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# Model P4: Add both Season and Year

# Model comparison

)

# Compare models
```

``` {r}
# Claude bias testing

# QUALITY CONTROL ANALYSIS: Testing for Observer and Location Bias

# First, explore the potential confounding variables
print("=== DATA EXPLORATION ===")
print("ProcessedBy summary:")
table(ShellPest2$ProcessedBy, ShellPest2$Year)

print("\nFixedLocation summary by Section:")
table(ShellPest2$FixedLocation, ShellPest2$Section)

print("\nFixedLocation summary by Year:")
table(ShellPest2$FixedLocation, ShellPest2$Year)

# Ensure factors are properly coded
ShellPest2$ProcessedBy <- as.factor(ShellPest2$ProcessedBy)
ShellPest2$FixedLocation <- as.factor(ShellPest2$FixedLocation)

# Check for potential confounding
print("\n=== CONFOUNDING CHECK ===")
print("Staff members by year (check if staff changed over time):")
staff_year <- table(ShellPest2$ProcessedBy, ShellPest2$Year)
print(staff_year)

print("\nStaff members by section (check if staff specialized in certain sections):")
staff_section <- table(ShellPest2$ProcessedBy, ShellPest2$Section)
print(staff_section)

print("\nFixed locations by year (check if locations changed over time):")
location_year <- table(ShellPest2$FixedLocation, ShellPest2$Year)
print(location_year[1:min(10, nrow(location_year)), ])  # Show first 10 locations

# BIAS TESTING MODELS

print("\n=== OBSERVER BIAS TESTING ===")

# Test 1: Add ProcessedBy to count models
model.B1_observer <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Season + Year + ProcessedBy,
                            dispformula = ~ Section,
                            ziformula = ~ 1,
                            family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                            data = ShellPest2,
                            control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                                   optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

#                                                   optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

print("\n=== LOCATION BIAS TESTING ===")

# Test 3: Add FixedLocation as random effect (nested within Section)
model.B2_location <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Season + Year + (1|FixedLocation),
                            dispformula = ~ Section,
                            ziformula = ~ 1,
                            family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                            data = ShellPest2,
                            control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim,

#                            data = ShellPest2,
#                            control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
#                                                   optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

print("\n=== COMBINED BIAS TESTING ===")

# Test 4: Both observer and location effects
model.B3_both <- glmmTMB(TotalClamCount ~ Section + TotalWeight_scaled + Season + Year + ProcessedBy + (1|FixedLocation),
                        dispformula = ~ Section,
                        ziformula = ~ 1,
                        family = nbinom2(link = "log"),
                        data = ShellPest2,
                        control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
                                               optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

#                        data = ShellPest2,
#                        control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim, 
#                                               optArgs = list(method = "BFGS")))

# MODEL COMPARISON: Original vs Bias-corrected models
library(AICcmodavg)

# For COUNT models
count_bias_models <- list(
  "Original" = model.A6,  # Your best original model
  "Observer_Bias" = model.B1_observer,
  "Location_Bias" = model.B2_location, 
  "Both_Biases" = model.B3_both
)

count_bias_comparison <- aictab(count_bias_models)
print("COUNT MODEL BIAS COMPARISON:")

# print(prev_bias_comparison)

# STATISTICAL TESTS for bias significance
print("\n=== SIGNIFICANCE TESTS ===")

# Test 1: Is ProcessedBy significant?
observer_count_test <- anova(model.A6, model.B1_observer)
print("Observer effect on COUNT model:")
print(observer_count_test)

# observer_prev_test <- anova(model.P4, model.P_observer)

# Test 2: Is FixedLocation significant?

# EFFECT SIZE ANALYSIS
print("\n=== OBSERVER BIAS MAGNITUDE ===")
if(any(grepl("Observer", count_bias_comparison$Modnames[1:2]))) {
  # If observer model is competitive, examine effect sizes
  library(emmeans)
  
  observer_effects_count <- emmeans(model.B1_observer, ~ ProcessedBy, type = "response")
  print("Count differences by observer:")
  observer_count_df <- as.data.frame(observer_effects_count)
  print(observer_count_df)
  
  # Calculate fold differences between observers
  max_observer <- max(observer_count_df$response)
  min_observer <- min(observer_count_df$response)
  observer_bias_ratio <- max_observer / min_observer
  print(paste("Maximum observer bias:", round(observer_bias_ratio, 2), "fold difference"))
}

print("\n=== LOCATION VARIABILITY ===")
if(any(grepl("Location", count_bias_comparison$Modnames[1:2]))) {
  # Extract random effect variance for FixedLocation
  location_variance <- VarCorr(model.B2_location)
  print("FixedLocation random effect variance:")
  print(location_variance)
}
```

``` {r}
# Claude

# BIAS-CORRECTED BIOLOGICAL INTERPRETATION
# Using the "Both_Biases" model as the most appropriate model

print("=== BIAS-CORRECTED MODEL SUMMARY ===")
print(summary(model.B3_both))

# Calculate R-squared to understand how much variation is explained
library(performance)
r2_corrected <- r2(model.B3_both)
print(paste("Conditional R² (total variation explained):", round(r2_corrected$R2_conditional, 3)))
print(paste("Marginal R² (fixed effects only):", round(r2_corrected$R2_marginal, 3)))

# BIOLOGICAL EFFECTS AFTER BIAS CORRECTION
print("\n=== ROBUST BIOLOGICAL PATTERNS ===")

# Extract coefficients for biological variables only
bio_coefs <- summary(model.B3_both)$coefficients$cond
bio_vars <- rownames(bio_coefs)[!grepl("ProcessedBy", rownames(bio_coefs))]
bio_effects <- bio_coefs[bio_vars, ]

print("Biological effects (bias-corrected):")
print(bio_effects)

# Convert to interpretable effects (fold changes)
print("\n=== FOLD-CHANGE INTERPRETATION ===")

# Section effects (relative to baseline Section W)
if("SectionC" %in% rownames(bio_effects)) {
  section_c_effect <- exp(bio_effects["SectionC", "Estimate"])
  section_c_p <- bio_effects["SectionC", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  print(paste("Section C vs W:", round(section_c_effect, 2), "x clams (p =", 
              format(section_c_p, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), ")"))
}

if("SectionE" %in% rownames(bio_effects)) {
  section_e_effect <- exp(bio_effects["SectionE", "Estimate"])
  section_e_p <- bio_effects["SectionE", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  print(paste("Section E vs W:", round(section_e_effect, 2), "x clams (p =", 
              format(section_e_p, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), ")"))
}

# Weight effect
if("TotalWeight_scaled" %in% rownames(bio_effects)) {
  weight_effect <- exp(bio_effects["TotalWeight_scaled", "Estimate"])
  weight_p <- bio_effects["TotalWeight_scaled", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  print(paste("Weight effect:", round(weight_effect, 2), "x clams per SD increase (p =", 
              format(weight_p, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3), ")"))
}

# Seasonal effects (relative to Winter baseline)
seasonal_vars <- grep("Season", rownames(bio_effects), value = TRUE)
if(length(seasonal_vars) > 0) {
  print("\nSeasonal effects (relative to Winter):")
  for(season_var in seasonal_vars) {
    season_effect <- exp(bio_effects[season_var, "Estimate"])
    season_p <- bio_effects[season_var, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    season_name <- gsub("Season", "", season_var)
    significance <- ifelse(season_p < 0.001, "***", 
                          ifelse(season_p < 0.01, "**",
                                ifelse(season_p < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
    print(paste(season_name, ":", round(season_effect, 2), "x clams", significance))
  }
}

# Yearly effects (relative to 2016 baseline)
yearly_vars <- grep("Year", rownames(bio_effects), value = TRUE)
if(length(yearly_vars) > 0) {
  print("\nYearly effects (relative to 2016) - BIAS CORRECTED:")
  for(year_var in yearly_vars) {
    year_effect <- exp(bio_effects[year_var, "Estimate"])
    year_p <- bio_effects[year_var, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    year_name <- gsub("Year", "", year_var)
    significance <- ifelse(year_p < 0.001, "***", 
                          ifelse(year_p < 0.01, "**",
                                ifelse(year_p < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
    print(paste(year_name, ":", round(year_effect, 2), "x clams", significance))
  }
}

# OBSERVER EFFECTS MAGNITUDE
print("\n=== OBSERVER BIAS MAGNITUDE ===")
observer_vars <- grep("ProcessedBy", rownames(bio_coefs), value = TRUE)
if(length(observer_vars) > 0) {
  observer_effects <- exp(bio_coefs[observer_vars, "Estimate"])
  observer_range <- max(observer_effects) / min(observer_effects)
  print(paste("Observer bias range:", round(observer_range, 2), "fold difference"))
  print(paste("Highest counting observer:", round(max(observer_effects), 2), "x baseline"))
  print(paste("Lowest counting observer:", round(min(observer_effects), 2), "x baseline"))
}

# LOCATION EFFECTS MAGNITUDE  
print("\n=== LOCATION VARIABILITY ===")
location_variance <- VarCorr(model.B3_both)
location_sd <- attr(location_variance$cond$FixedLocation, "stddev")
print(paste("Location random effect SD:", round(location_sd, 3)))
print(paste("Location effect: ~", round(exp(2 * location_sd), 1), 
            "fold range between high/low locations"))

print("\n=== COMPARISON: ORIGINAL vs BIAS-CORRECTED ===")

# Compare key effects between models
print("Section E effect:")
original_section_e <- exp(1.16136)  # From your original model summary
corrected_section_e <- ifelse("SectionE" %in% rownames(bio_effects), 
                              exp(bio_effects["SectionE", "Estimate"]), NA)
print(paste("Original model:", round(original_section_e, 2), "x"))
print(paste("Bias-corrected:", round(corrected_section_e, 2), "x"))
print(paste("Bias inflation:", round(original_section_e / corrected_section_e, 2), "x"))

# Extract and visualize the bias-corrected temporal patterns
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

# Get bias-corrected predictions for visualization
print("\n=== BIAS-CORRECTED SEASONAL PATTERNS ===")
if(length(seasonal_vars) > 0) {
  season_corrected <- emmeans(model.B3_both, ~ Season, type = "response")
  season_corrected_df <- as.data.frame(season_corrected)
  print(season_corrected_df)
  
  # Plot corrected seasonal pattern
  p_season_corrected <- ggplot(season_corrected_df, aes(x = Season, y = response)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.2, size = 1) +
    labs(title = "BIAS-CORRECTED Seasonal Pattern", 
         subtitle = "After accounting for observer and location effects",
         y = "Predicted Clam Count", x = "Season") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  print(p_season_corrected)
}

print("\n=== BIAS-CORRECTED YEARLY PATTERNS ===")
if(length(yearly_vars) > 0) {
  year_corrected <- emmeans(model.B3_both, ~ Year, type = "response")
  year_corrected_df <- as.data.frame(year_corrected)
  print(year_corrected_df)
  
  # Plot corrected yearly pattern
  year_corrected_df$Year_num <- as.numeric(as.character(year_corrected_df$Year))
  p_year_corrected <- ggplot(year_corrected_df, aes(x = Year_num, y = response)) +
    geom_line(size = 1, color = "darkblue") +
    geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkblue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.2) +
    labs(title = "BIAS-CORRECTED Yearly Pattern", 
         subtitle = "After accounting for observer and location effects",
         y = "Predicted Clam Count", x = "Year") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
  
  print(p_year_corrected)
}

print("\n=== SCIENTIFIC CONCLUSIONS ===")
print("ROBUST biological patterns (after bias correction):")
print("1. Weight effect remains strong - biological signal")
print("2. Section differences remain but magnitude reduced")
print("3. Temporal patterns require careful interpretation")
print("4. Observer training/standardization is critical for future work")
print("5. Location effects are substantial - site selection matters")
```
